entities.name: Hafiz-i Abru
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Hafez-e Abru was a Persian historian working at the courts of Timurid rulers of Central Asia. His full name is 
ʿAbdallah Ebn Lotf-Allah Ebn 'Abd-al-Rashid Behdadini; his short name is also transcribed in Western literature as Hafiz-i Abru, Hafez-e Abru, Hafiz Abru etc.
